columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Primary key populated from a sequence.

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: Time this event occurred, or when it started.

columns.name: START_DATE_TRUNC
columns.description: A representation of the start time truncated to the day.

columns.name: START_TIME_HH24MI
columns.description: A representation of the start time via to_number('hh24mi').

columns.name: END_TIME
columns.description: The time that this event ended.

columns.name: END_DATE_TRUNC
columns.description: A representation of the end time truncated to the day.

columns.name: END_TIME_HH24MI
columns.description: A representation of the end time via to_number('HH24MI').

columns.name: DURATION_MS
columns.description: Difference between end time and start time in milliseconds.

columns.name: SUBMIT_TIME
columns.description: The time that the underlying work object was submitted.

columns.name: SUBMIT_DATE_TRUNC
columns.description: The date the underlying work object was submitted, truncated to the day.

columns.name: EVENT_NAME_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the name of the event.

columns.name: VALUE
columns.description: A value associated with the event.  The meaning of the value is event specific.

columns.name: RESOURCE_PARTY_ID
columns.description: ID of agent in HZ_PARTIES.PARTY_ID.

columns.name: CONTACT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the customer contact, from HZ_PARTIES.PARTY_ID.

columns.name: INTERACTION_ID
columns.description: ID of interaction associated with this event.

columns.name: CHANNEL_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that identifies the channel type.

columns.name: CHANNEL_ID
columns.description: ID that identifies the channel associated with this event.

columns.name: QUEUE_ID
columns.description: ID of the queue associated with this event.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE_CD
columns.description: The object type associated with this event

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Business Object ID associated with this event

columns.name: WORK_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: The Id of the Work Object in the SVC_WORK_OBJECTS table related to this event.

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: The priority of the Work Object Id associated with this event.

columns.name: BU_ORG_ID
columns.description: Reserved for future use. Identifies the Business Unit Org Id associated with this event.

columns.name: STRIPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the stripe code, such as CRM, HCM, or PRM.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
